headline: Nine more cabinets take the Y key
lede: WATCH rollout batch 2: the forge's proven brains now drive Out Run's highway, the Lunar Lander's descent, an entire outpost colony and seven more titles — any key, tap or stick takes the controls straight back.

notes.text: Seven reactive brains wired — each is the exact per-tick decision its Node harness already grades (outreach 36, polar 154, outpost 627, lander 44 gates all green), so the demo you watch is the proof you get. Smash TV seats only the first player: your partner keeps their stick.

Two games get an honest junction instead of a fake route: Paperboy's proven pedal-line seats only at a street edge where the road still matches the witness, and Ice Climber re-plans its three mountains from wherever your dwarves actually stand — mid-stage, both simply say 'no guide yet'.
Space Invaders stays without a button until a full-game route exists — the no-fake-demos clause, enforced.
watchcheck now carries 36 pilots; this box's Chrome is still out with the studio-wide React split, so they go green the moment browsers recover.
